author: Kathryn Jill Shannon
text:
I don't think Libre are for me.
I swim, hot sauna, exercise, they don't last long at all before falling off or simply stop working.
I do turn the alarms off overnight to silence  the side sleeping compression lows.

author: Carol Giraudin
text: First few months I had no problem with them. And during the low readings the sensor was not compressed but sleeping or leaning on it. Had issues with the last 2 sensors .
